164                if (horus_yaribay == null) return false;

219
220                addLargeSons();

222                maeus_moroz = getImportantPerson(People.MAEUS_MOROZ);
223                if(maeus_moroz == null) return false;

225

227                //"Dec 11, c205"
228                //"205.12.11"

230                if(cydoniaDate == null) {
231                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate", "Dec 11, c205");
232                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate2", "205.12.11");
233                        //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate", Global.getSector().getClock().getDateString());  //getShortDate());
234                        //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate2", Global.getSector().getClock().getShortDate());
235                }
236                
237                aureolinColor = new Color(210,175,170,255);
238                crasisColor = new Color(150,165,190,255);
239                
240                /*
241                volturn = getMarket("volturn");
242                if (volturn == null) return false;
243                if (!volturn.getFactionId().equals("sindrian_diktat")) return false;
244                
245                sindria = getMarket("sindria");
246                if (sindria == null) return false;
247                if (!sindria.getFactionId().equals("sindrian_diktat")) return false;
248                */
249                
250

252                hercules = getImportantPerson(People.HERCULES);
253                achilles = getImportantPerson(People.ACHILLES);

255                setStoryMission();
256                setStartingStage(Stage.CRACK_FILES);

258

261                
262                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_ARROYO, "$sd7s_decryptViaArroyo");
263                makeImportant(arroyo, "$sd7s_decrypt", Stage.TALK_ARROYO);
264                
265                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_INESIS, "$sd7s_decryptViaInesis");
266                makeImportant(inesis, "$sd7s_decrypt", Stage.TALK_INESIS);
267                
268                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_SIYAVONG, "$sd7s_decryptViaSiyavong");
269                makeImportant(siyavong, "$sd7s_decrypt", Stage.TALK_SIYAVONG);
270

283                // and the other two are asteroids spawn in-situ

286

289
290

292                triggerSetGlobalMemoryValue("$sd7s_missionCompleted", true);
293                triggerMakeNonStoryCritical(orthrus, yesod, qaras, nomios);
294                endTrigger();
295                
296                return true;
297        }

299        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
300                set("$sd7s_stage", getCurrentStage());
301                set("$sd7s_crasisColor", new Color(140,170,225,255)); // Color(140,225,170,255)); 
302                set("$sd7s_aureolinColor", new Color(230,180,160,255)); // Color(230,220,160,255)); 
303                set("$sd7s_sonsFoundCount", getSonsFoundCount());
304                
305                aiColony = findColonyWithAIAdmin();
306                if(aiColony == null) {
307                        set("$sd7s_playerHasAIAdmin", false);
308                }
309                else {
310                        set("$sd7s_playerHasAIAdmin", true);
311                        set("$sd7s_aiColonyName", aiColony.getName());
312                        set("$sd7s_aiColonySystemName", aiColony.getStarSystem().getName());
313                }
314        }

316        public void buttonPressConfirmed(Object buttonId, IntelUIAPI ui) {
317                if (buttonId == SevenSonsIntel.BUTTON_SHOW_SEVEN_SONS) {
318                        SevenSonsIntel.toggleSonsList(this, ui);
319                        return;
320                }
321                else if (buttonId == SevenSonsIntel.BUTTON_SONS_INTEL_DIALOG) {
322                        // launch dialog here.
323                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("SevenSonsAndradaFileBegin");
324                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().showInteractionDialogFromCargo(plugin, 
325                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), new DismissDialogDelegate() {
326                                        @Override
327                                        public void dialogDismissed() {}
328                                });
329                        return;
330                }
331                else if (buttonId == SevenSonsIntel.BUTTON_SONS_DECRYPT_DIALOG) {
332                        // launch dialog here.
333                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("SevenSonsAndradaDecryptBegin");
334                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().showInteractionDialogFromCargo(plugin, 
335                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), new DismissDialogDelegate() {
336                                        @Override
337                                        public void dialogDismissed() {
338                                                ui.updateUIForItem(SDSevenSons.this);
339                                                
340                                        }
341                                });
342                        return;
343                }
344                super.buttonPressConfirmed(buttonId, ui);
345        }

361        @Override
362        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
363                                                                 List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
364                
365                if("setupSons".equals(action)) 
366                {
367                        addLocations();
368                        return true;
369                }
370                else if ("giveFoundXP".equals(action)) 
371                {
372                        num_rewards_given++;
373                        long xp_to_give = (long)(num_rewards_given * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
374                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addXP(xp_to_give, dialog.getTextPanel());
375                        return true;
376                }
377                else if ("makeAIColonyImportant".equals(action)) {
378                        makeImportant(aiColony, "$sd7s_decrypt", Stage.TALK_TO_AI);
379                        return true;
380                }
381                else if ("giveLastFoundXP".equals(action))
382                {
383                        num_rewards_given++;
384                        long xp_to_give = (long)(num_rewards_given * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
385                        
386                        if (num_rewards_given < sonsFoundCount)
387                        {
388                                for (int i = num_rewards_given; i < sonsFoundCount; i++)
389                                {
390                                        xp_to_give += (long)(i * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
391                                }
392                        }
393                        
394                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addXP(xp_to_give, dialog.getTextPanel());
395                        return true;
396                }
397                else if ("checkSonsFound".equals(action)) {
398                        
399                        getSonsFoundCount();
400                        //System.out.print("checkShrinesVisited = " + Integer.toString(visited_shrines));
401                        
402                        if( sonsFoundCount >= numberOfSons) {
403                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_foundAllSons", true);
404                        }
405                        return true;
406                }
407                //else if ("makeCydoniaImportant".equals(action)) {
408                //      makeImportant(cydonia, "$perseusInfo"); // "$sd7s_findPerseus", Stage.FIND_THEM);
409                //      return true;
410                //}
411                else if ("damageFleet".equals(action)) {
412                        damageFleet(4f,2);
413                        return true;
414                }
415                else if ("damageFleetMore".equals(action)) {
416                        damageFleet(8f,4);
417                        return true;
418                }
419                else if ("spawnIrkallaMerc".equals(action)) {
420                        spawnIrkallaMercFleet();
421                        return true;
422                }
423                else if ("spawnElysiumMerc".equals(action)) {
424                        spawnElysiumMercFleet();
425                        return true;
426                }
427                else if ("spawnMorozFleet".equals(action)) {
428                        spawnMorozFleet(random, false);
429                        return true;
430                }
431                else if ("changeTitle".equals(action)) {
432                        useSons = true;
433                        return true;
434                }
435                else if ("saveTheDate".equals(action)) {
436                        
437                        //System.out.println("SD7S doing saveTheData");
438                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate", Global.getSector().getClock().getDateString());  //getShortDate());
439                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate2", Global.getSector().getClock().getShortDate());
440                        return true;
441                }
442                else if ("shootEm".equals(action)) {
443                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("storyevent_diktat_execution", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
444                        return true;
445                }
446                else if ("goBoom".equals(action)) {
447                        
448                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("explosion_from_damage", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
449                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("collision_asteroids", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
450                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("collision_ships", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
451                        return true;
452                }
453                else if ("addIntelImageIrkalla".equals(action)) {
454                        TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
455                        text.addImage("intel", "sd7s_irkalla");
456                        return true;
457                }
458                else if ("addIntelImageElysium".equals(action)) {
459                        TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
460                        text.addImage("intel", "sd7s_elysium");
461                        return true;
462                }
463                //else if ("createQarasAgentAndFleet".equals(action)) {
464                //      return createQarasAgentAndFleet();
465                //}
466                else if ("annoyQaras".equals(action)) {
467                        if (dialog == null) return false;
468                
469                        WeightedRandomPicker<PersonAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PersonAPI>();
470                        for (PersonDataAPI pd : Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPeopleCopy()) {
471                                PersonAPI person = pd.getPerson();
472                                if(!person.getId().equals(People.KO_JOVE)) 
473                                        if (    Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
474                                                        Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
475                                                        Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
476                                                        Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId())) {
477                                                
478                                                picker.add(person);
479                                        }
480                        }
481                        
482                        int num = 4; //Misc.random.nextInt(2) + 1;
483                        for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
484                                PersonAPI person = picker.pick();
485                                CustomRepImpact custom = new CustomRepImpact();
486                                custom.delta = -RepRewards.HIGH;
487                                Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
488                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, custom,
489                                                                                          null, dialog.getTextPanel(), true, true), 
490                                                                                          person);
491                        }
492                        
493                        return true;
494                }
495                else if ("makeHorusImportant".equals(action)) {
496                        makeImportant(horus_yaribay, "$sd7s_bringFiles", Stage.CRACK_FILES);
497                        return true;
498                }
499                else if ("makeReynardImportant".equals(action)) {
500                        makeImportant(reynard_hannan, "$sd7s_bringFiles", Stage.CRACK_FILES);
501                        return true;
502                }
503                else if ("makeDaudImportant".equals(action)) {
504                        PersonAPI _daud = getImportantPerson(People.DAUD);
505                        if(_daud == null) {
506                                // Oh, that's not good.
507                                return false;
508                        }
509                        makeImportant(_daud, "$sd7s_bringFiles", Stage.CRACK_FILES);
510                        return true;
511                }
512                else if ("makeArroyoImportant".equals(action)) {
513                        makeImportant(arroyo, "$sd7s_bringFiles", Stage.CRACK_FILES);
514                        return true;
515                }
516                else if ("makeZGRimportant".equals(action)) {
517                        if(zgr == null)
518                                zgr = getImportantPerson(People.GLAMOR_ROTANEV);
519                        if (zgr == null) return false;
520                        makeImportant(zgr, "$sd7s_bringFiles", Stage.CRACK_FILES);
521                        return true;
522                }
523                else if ("purgeNomios".equals(action)) {
524                        //log.info("called purgeNomios");
525                        //PersonAPI nomiosSO;
526                        //PersonAPI nomiosPM;
527                        
528                        if(nomios == null) return false;
529                        List<PersonAPI> nomiosPeople = nomios.getPeopleCopy();
530                        for(PersonAPI oldPerson : nomiosPeople) {
531                                //log.info("found person: " + oldPerson.getNameString() + ", who is the " + oldPerson.getPostId() );
532                                if(     oldPerson.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER) ||
533                                        oldPerson.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_SUPPLY_OFFICER)) 
534                                {
535                                        String postID = oldPerson.getPostId();
536                                        //oldPerson.addTag(Tags.INVOLUNTARY_RETIREMENT);
537                                        oldPerson.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$former_" + oldPerson.getPostId(), true);
538                                        oldPerson.setPostId(Ranks.POST_CITIZEN);
539                                        //nomios.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
540                                        
541                                        
542                                        PersonAPI newPerson = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT).createRandomPerson();
543                                        //newPerson.addTag("replacement");
544                                        newPerson.setPostId(postID);
545                                        newPerson.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$replacement", true);
546                                        nomios.addPerson(newPerson);
547                                        nomios.getCommDirectory().addPerson(newPerson);
548                                        nomios.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(newPerson).setHidden(false);
549                                        
550                                        nomios.getCommDirectory().removePerson(oldPerson);
551                                        nomios.getCommDirectory().addPerson(oldPerson, 1000); // back of the comm directory for you, buddy
552                                        //nomios.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person.getId()).setHidden(true);
553                                        
554                                        //log.info("    replacing them with new person: " + newPerson.getNameString());
555                                        
556                                        // make sure the portraits are different, for the love of god.
557                                        // I really don't want to add a while loop here, so maybe it's good enough like this?
558                                        // Well, should reduce instances of (more) clones by quite a lot, at least. -dgb
559                                        
560                                        // Uncomment this to test the "ensure not same portrait" code
561                                        //newPerson.setPortraitSprite(oldPerson.getPortraitSprite());
562                                        
563                                        if (oldPerson.getPortraitSprite().equals(newPerson.getPortraitSprite())) {
564                                                WeightedRandomPicker<String> portraits = newPerson.getFaction().getPortraits(newPerson.getGender()).clone();
565                                                portraits.remove(oldPerson.getPortraitSprite());
566                                                String portrait = portraits.pick();
567                                                if (portrait != null) { // would be null if the faction somehow only had that one portrait
568                                                        newPerson.setPortraitSprite(portrait);
569                                                }
570                                        }
571                                }
572                        }
573                        return true;
574                }
575        
576                // Seven Sons intel.
577                SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
578                if (entity.getMarket() != null && !entity.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) {
579                        PlanetAPI planet = entity.getMarket().getPlanetEntity();
580                        if (planet != null) {
581                                entity = planet;
582                        }
583                        // TODO try station/custom_entity too?
584                        // Irkalla and Elysium aren't being caught here, maybe?
585                }
586                
587                if ("addIntel".equals(action)) {
588                        if (params.size() > 1) {
589                                String id = params.get(1).getString(memoryMap);
590                                entity = SevenSonsIntel.getEntity(id);
591                        }
592                        SevenSonsIntel.addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(entity, dialog.getTextPanel());
593                        return true;
594                } 
595                else if ("setVisited".equals(action)) {
596                        if (params.size() > 1) {
597                                String id = params.get(1).getString(memoryMap);
598                                entity = SevenSonsIntel.getEntity(id);
599                        }
600                        SevenSonsIntel.addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(entity, dialog.getTextPanel(), true);
601                        SevenSonsIntel.setVisited(entity, dialog.getTextPanel());
602                        
603                        //System.out.println("received setVisited for entity id: " + entity.getId());
604                        
605                        // and make unimportant to this mission.
606                        Misc.makeUnimportant(entity, getMissionId());
607                        
608                        return true;    
609                } 
610                /*else if ("playMusic".equals(action)) {
611                        String shrineMusic = "music_luddite_shrine";
612                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playCustomMusic(1, 1, shrineMusic, true);
613                        // failsafe is not actually necessary; leaving the entity will give the music player a kick anyway
614//                      if (!Global.getSector().hasScript(ShrineMusicStopFailsafe.class)) {
615//                              Global.getSector().addScript(new ShrineMusicStopFailsafe(shrineMusic));
616//                      }
617                } else if ("endMusic".equals(action)) {
618                        Global.getSoundPlayer().restartCurrentMusic();
619                }*/
620                
621                
622                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
623        }

934        private void damageFleet( float damageMult, int numTargets) {
935                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
936                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> targets = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
937                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
938                        float w = 1f;
939                        switch (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
940                                case CAPITAL_SHIP: w = 12f; break;
941                                case CRUISER: w = 8f; break;
942                                case DESTROYER: w = 4f; break;
943                                case FRIGATE: w = 2f; break;
944                        }
945                        targets.add(member, w);
946                }
947                
948                for (int i = 0; i < numTargets; i++) {
949                        FleetMemberAPI member = targets.pick();
950                        if (member != null) {
951                                Misc.applyDamage(member, null, damageMult, true, "asteroid_base_defenses", "Asteroid base defenses",
952                                                                 true, null, member.getShipName() + " suffers damage from asteroid base defenses");
953                        }
954                        
955                        damageMult--;
956                        if(damageMult == 0f) 
957                                damageMult = 1f;
958                }
959                
960                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("hit_heavy", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
961        }

1130                if( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(FOUND_HERCULES) == true) _count++;

1134                if( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(FOUND_LEONIDAS) == true) _count++;

1537                        FIDConfig config = new FIDConfig();
1538
1539                        config.showTransponderStatus = false;
1540                        config.showEngageText = false;
1541                        config.alwaysPursue = true;
1542                        config.dismissOnLeave = false;
1543                        config.withSalvage = false;
1544                        config.printXPToDialog = true;
1545                        config.noSalvageLeaveOptionText = "Continue";
1546
1547                        config.delegate = new BaseFIDDelegate() {
1548                                public void postPlayerSalvageGeneration(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, FleetEncounterContext context, CargoAPI salvage) {
1549                                        new RemnantFleetInteractionConfigGen().createConfig().delegate.postPlayerSalvageGeneration(dialog, context, salvage);
1550                                }

1552                                public void notifyLeave(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
1553                                        
1554                                        SectorEntityToken other = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
1555                                        if (!(other instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) {
1556                                                dialog.dismiss();
1557                                                return;
1558                                        }
1559                                        
1560                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) other;
1561                                        if (!fleet.isEmpty()) {
1562                                                dialog.dismiss();
1563                                                return;
1564                                        }
1565                                        
1566                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(DEFEATED_QARAS_AGENT_FLEET, true);
1567                                        
1568                                        dialog.setInteractionTarget(fleet);
1569                                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("SD7SQarasAgentDefeated");
1570                                        dialog.setPlugin(plugin);
1571                                        plugin.init(dialog);
1572                                }
1573                                
1574                        };
1575                        
1576                        return config;  
1577                }
1578        }

1580        protected MarketAPI findColonyWithAIAdmin() {
1581                // This is called by updateInteractionDataImpl()
1582                
1583                float bestScore = 0f;
1584                MarketAPI best = null;
1585                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false)) {
1586                        if (market.getAdmin() != null && market.getAdmin().isAICore()) {
1587                                float score = market.getSize() * 1000000f + market.getDaysInExistence();
1588                                if (score > bestScore) {
1589                                        best = market;
1590                                        bestScore = score;
1591                                }
1592                        }
1593                }
1594                return best;
1595        }
